title: ArXiv receives multiyear commitments to support it as an independent nonprofit
title_zh: ArXiv获得多年投资支持成为独立非营利组织

paragraphs.en: arXiv is pleased to announce that three leading philanthropic organizations have provided multimillion-dollar support for arXiv. These new multiyear philanthropic commitments from Simons Foundation International, XTX Markets, and Siegel Family Endowment will support platform development, organizational capacity, and overall provide foundational support to arXiv’s establishment as an independent nonprofit. The $17.2 million investment, spanning three to five years, will support arXiv as it transitions to independence by strengthening its technical infrastructure, supporting ongoing operations, and improving services for researchers around the world.
paragraphs.zh: arXiv 很高兴地宣布，三家领先的慈善机构已为 arXiv 提供了数百万美元的支持。 西蒙斯基金会国际、XTX Markets 和西格尔家族基金会这些新的多年期慈善承诺，将支持平台开发、组织能力建设，并总体上为 arXiv 成为一家独立非营利组织的确立提供基础性支持。 这笔为期三至五年、总额 1720 万美元的投资，将通过加强技术基础设施、支持日常运营和改善面向全球研究者的服务，助力 arXiv 实现独立。

sents.en: The $17.2 million investment, spanning three to five years, will support arXiv as it transitions to independence by strengthening its technical infrastructure, supporting ongoing operations, and improving services for researchers around the world.
sents.zh: 这笔为期三至五年、总额 1720 万美元的投资，将通过加强技术基础设施、支持日常运营和改善面向全球研究者的服务，助力 arXiv 实现独立。

paragraphs.en: For three and a half decades, arXiv has been a trusted venue where researchers can share and access scientific findings. Today, we serve millions of users annually and play an essential role in scholarly communication across physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, electrical engineering and systems science, and economics.
paragraphs.zh: 三十五年来，arXiv 一直是一个值得信赖的平台，研究人员可以在这里分享和获取科学成果。 如今，我们每年为数百万用户提供服务，在物理学、数学、计算机科学、定量生物学、定量金融学、统计学、电气工程与系统科学以及经济学等领域的学术交流中发挥着重要作用。

paragraphs.en: I am grateful for the commitments from Simons Foundation International, XTX Markets, and Siegel Family Endowment, which put arXiv on solid footing as we move into this next chapter. Their generous support provides a strong foundation and momentum for arXiv to continue to grow and serve the research community for the long term.” The new commitments build on previous philanthropic support for arXiv. arXiv gratefully acknowledges their community-based donors, including member organizations, foundations, affiliates, sponsors, and longstanding supporters.
paragraphs.zh: 我感谢西蒙斯国际基金会（Simons Foundation International）、XTX Markets 和西格尔家族基金会（Siegel Family Endowment）的承诺支持，它们让 arXiv 在迈入新篇章之际站稳了脚跟。 他们的慷慨支持为 arXiv 提供了坚实的基础和持续增长、长期服务科研界的动力。” 这些新的承诺建立在以往对 arXiv 的慈善支持之上。arXiv 感谢其社区捐赠者，包括成员机构、基金会、附属机构、赞助商以及长期支持者。

paragraphs.en: These new commitments will support three core areas of work:
paragraphs.zh: 这些新的承诺将支持三个核心工作领域：

paragraphs.en: Building on the Simons Foundation’s long-standing support of arXiv, Simons Foundation International has made a new multi-year commitment to support the organization’s next phase as an independent nonprofit.
paragraphs.zh: 在西蒙斯基金会长期支持 arXiv 的基础上，西蒙斯基金会国际（Simons Foundation International）作出了一项新的多年期承诺，以支持该组织作为独立非营利组织的下一阶段发展。

paragraphs.en: For 35 years, arXiv has made math and science more open, transparent, accessible and collaborative. By growing into an independent nonprofit, arXiv will be positioned to evolve and modernize its systems to better serve the scientific community and to secure its future.
paragraphs.zh: 35年来，arXiv 使数学与科学变得更加开放、透明、可及和协作。 通过成长为一家独立的非营利组织，arXiv 将有能力对其系统进行演进和现代化改造，以更好地服务科学界并保障其未来。

paragraphs.en: XTX Markets and its founder, Alex Gerko, have supported arXiv’s mission for the past two years. The firm is now making a new multi-year commitment to strengthen arXiv’s role as a trusted platform for open scientific research.
paragraphs.zh: XTX Markets 及其创始人 Alex Gerko 在过去两年中一直支持 arXiv 的使命。 该公司现在作出一项新的多年期承诺，以加强 arXiv 作为开放科学研究可信平台的作用。

sents.en: XTX Markets and its founder, Alex Gerko, have supported arXiv’s mission for the past two years.
sents.zh: XTX Markets 及其创始人 Alex Gerko 在过去两年中一直支持 arXiv 的使命。

sents.en: The firm is now making a new multi-year commitment to strengthen arXiv’s role as a trusted platform for open scientific research.
sents.zh: 该公司现在作出一项新的多年期承诺，以加强 arXiv 作为开放科学研究可信平台的作用。

paragraphs.en: For decades, arXiv has been an important bedrock for open science. Now, with rapid advances in AI driving changes across academia, it is even more valuable to have robust, open-source infrastructure for science. XTX Markets is delighted to continue our support for arXiv in this important endeavor.
paragraphs.zh: 几十年来，arXiv 一直是开放科学的重要基石。 如今，随着人工智能的快速发展推动整个学术界发生变革，拥有健全的开源科学基础设施就显得更加有价值。 XTX Markets 很高兴能继续在这一重要事业中支持 arXiv。

sents.zh: XTX Markets 很高兴能继续在这一重要事业中支持 arXiv。

paragraphs.en: Siegel Family Endowment has made a multi-year commitment to arXiv, advancing a shared vision for equitable digital infrastructure and open knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: Siegel Family Endowment 对 arXiv 作出了多年期承诺，共同推进公平的数字基础设施与开放知识的共同愿景。

paragraphs.en: Open access to knowledge is a cornerstone of a healthy research ecosystem, but it is also essential to a thriving digital ecosystem and to ensuring people can equitably access and participate in the knowledge that shapes our world. We’re looking forward to supporting arXiv in its next chapter as essential infrastructure, enabling communities to share ideas, build on one another’s work, and sustain a living body of knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 开放获取知识是健康研究生态系统的基石，同时也是繁荣的数字生态系统以及确保人们能够公平地获取并参与塑造我们世界的知识所不可或缺的。 我们期待支持 arXiv 迈入其作为关键基础设施的新篇章，使各社区能够分享想法、在彼此的工作基础上继续构建，并维护一个充满活力的知识体系。

paragraphs.en: We are especially grateful to our major funders , who trust in arXiv’s important work, and are committed to our vision. Our major funders create a solid foundation of support and are an essential part of arXiv’s sustainable funding model, which is supplemented by our membership program , as well as our sponsors , our affiliates , and individual donors. Thank you for your unwavering support of arXiv!
paragraphs.zh: 我们特别感谢我们的主要资助者，他们信任 arXiv 的重要工作，并致力于我们的愿景。 我们的主要资助者为支持奠定了坚实的基础，是 arXiv 可持续资助模式的重要组成部分，这一模式还得到我们的会员计划以及我们的赞助商、合作机构和个人捐赠者的补充。 感谢您对 arXiv 始终不渝的支持！
